nodes.name: Query Supabase API - Get Alerts

nodes.name: Group Alerts by Sales Rep
nodes.notes: Groups alerts by sales representative and counts severity

parameters.jsCode:
// Build HTML email for each sales rep const repData = $input.item.json; const repName = repData.representative_name || 'Sales Representative'; const criticalCount = repData.critical_count || 0; const warningCount = repData.warning_count || 0; const alerts = repData.alerts || []; // Sort alerts: critical first, then by days of inventory alerts.sort((a, b) => { if (a.is_critical && !b.is_critical) return -1; if (!a.is_critical && b.is_critical) return 1; if (a.days_of_inventory === null) return -1; if (b.days_of_inventory === null) return 1; return (a.days_of_inventory || 0) - (b.days_of_inventory || 0); }); // Generate HTML rows let alertRows = ''; for (const alert of alerts) { const severity = alert.is_critical ? 'CRITICAL' : 'WARNING'; const severityColor = alert.is_critical ? '#dc2626' : '#f59e0b'; const daysText = alert.days_of_inventory === null || alert.days_of_inventory === undefined ? 'RUPTURE (0 inventory)' : `${alert.days_of_inventory.toFixed(1)} days`; const qtyText = alert.qty_inventory || 0; const avgSalesText = alert.avg_weekly_sales ? alert.avg_weekly_sales.toFixed(1) : 'N/A'; alertRows += ` ${severity} ${alert.product_name}
${alert.format} | ${alert.category}
SAQ: ${alert.saq_code} ${alert.store_name}
${alert.store_city}, ${alert.store_region}
Store #${alert.store_number} ${qtyText} bottles ${avgSalesText} btl/week ${daysText} `; } // Build complete HTML email const htmlEmail = ` SAQ Inventory Alerts

🚨 Cherry River - SAQ Inventory Alerts

Daily Stock Monitoring Report

Hello ${repName},

You have ${criticalCount} CRITICAL and ${warningCount} WARNING inventory alerts requiring your attention.

Alert Types:
🔴 CRITICAL: Less than 7 days of inventory OR Rupture (0 stock)
🟡 WARNING: Less than 14 days of inventory

${alertRows}
Severity Product Store Current Stock Avg Weekly Sales Days Left

📋 Recommended Actions

  • CRITICAL alerts: Contact store managers immediately to arrange restocking
  • WARNING alerts: Schedule restocking within the next 7 days
  • RUPTURE alerts: Prioritize - Zero inventory means lost sales
  • Check with warehouse team for product availability

This is an automated report from Cherry River's SAQ Inventory Management System.
Report generated on ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' })}

Questions? Contact your territory manager or email support@cherryriver.ca

`; // Email subject line const subject = `🚨 SAQ Inventory Alerts: ${criticalCount} Critical, ${warningCount} Warning - ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}`; return { json: { to: repData.representative_email, representative_name: repName, subject: subject, html: htmlEmail, critical_count: criticalCount, warning_count: warningCount, total_alerts: alerts.length } };
